scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus is restrained at a stone pillar in a sunlit courtyard as a Roman attendant raises a scourge; Pilate watches from a raised seat.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:1, whose Greek text and Berean Interlinear glosses say that Pilate took Jesus and flogged him. The setting, attendants, and Pilate's presence at the scene are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Soldiers place a woven crown of thorns on Jesus' head and drape a purple robe around His shoulders as He sits in a stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:2, in which soldiers twist together a crown of thorns, put it on His head, and cast a purple robe around Him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with his hands bound as a man strikes his cheek with an open palm and others mock him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:3: people come to Jesus, hail him as king of the Jews, and strike him with their palms. The setting, clothing, and individual gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate addresses a gathered crowd outside a stone building, gesturing toward Jesus standing in the doorway with guards behind Him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Pilate going outside and announcing that he will bring Jesus out, having found no guilt in Him. The setting, figures, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands outside a stone doorway wearing a crown of thorns and a purple robe, while a man gestures toward listeners gathered in a courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 19:5: Jesus comes outside wearing the crown of thorns and purple robe, and a speaker presents him to those present. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with his hands bound as chief priests and officers gesture and cry out around him; Pilate addresses them from a seat in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:6, when the chief priests and officers call for Jesus to be crucified and Pilate says he finds no guilt in him. The setting, appearance and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of Jewish speakers address a seated official in a sunlit stone courtyard while Jesus stands nearby, listening.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the response in John 19:7: the speakers appeal to their law and say that he ought to die because he made himself the Son of God. The setting, gestures, and appearances are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An apprehensive Pilate sits in a stone hall, listening to a man who gestures toward him, while Roman guards and other figures stand nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:8: Pilate becomes more afraid after hearing a word. The scene, speaker, and setting are artistic details; the verse does not specify the word’s content.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit Roman praetorium, a seated governor extends a questioning hand toward Jesus, who stands silently with his hands bound; guards stand nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:9: the governor questions Jesus about where he is from, and Jesus gives him no answer. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate, seated in Roman attire, gestures toward a quiet Jesus in a sunlit stone hall, with Roman guards in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 19:10, where Pilate questions Jesus and asserts his authority to release or crucify him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he speaks to a seated authority figure in a sunlit stone hall, while a guard stands nearby and distant figures appear in the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus answering about authority given from above and the greater sin of the one who delivered him up; the light and setting are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures with an open hand as Jesus stands beside him and a group calls out from the courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:12: Pilate seeks to release Jesus while people cry out against releasing him, appealing to loyalty to Caesar.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in a stone-paved courtyard before Pilate, who is seated on a raised judgment seat, with Roman guards and a crowd nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 19:13, showing Jesus brought outside and Pilate seated at the judgment seat at the Stone Pavement, called Gabbatha. The setting and visual details are the artist’s interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A Roman governor gestures toward Jesus, whose hands are bound, as people gather below in a sunlit stone courtyard, with soldiers and Jerusalem behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the moment in John 19:14 when, on the Day of Preparation of the Passover at about the sixth hour, the speaker presents the king to the Jewish people. The setting, figures, and visual details are the artist's interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate gestures toward chief priests and a crowd in a sunlit stone courtyard, while Jesus stands quietly beside him and Roman guards watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:15: the crowd calls for Jesus to be taken away and crucified, Pilate asks about crucifying their king, and the chief priests answer that they have no king except Caesar. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, with his hands bound, is led by guards in a sunlit stone courtyard as an official gestures toward them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus being handed over and taken, as described in John 19:16; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus carries a large wooden cross along a rocky path beyond a stone city, with figures behind him and a distant hill beneath a blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:17, in which he bears his own cross and goes out to the place called Golgotha. The landscape, figures, and distant crosses are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor scene of Jesus crucified on the central cross, with two other men on crosses on either side, above a rocky landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 19:18: Jesus is crucified between two others, one on each side. The landscape and visual details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus hangs on a wooden cross beneath a plain wooden plaque, with onlookers and Roman soldiers in a sunlit, rocky landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:19, in which Pilate writes a title and places it on the cross identifying Jesus of Nazareth as King of the Jews. The plaque is shown without lettering.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd looks up at Jesus on the cross and a blank plaque above him, near the stone walls of a city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:20, where many Jews read the title at the place near the city where Jesus was crucified. The verse says the title was written in Hebrew, Latin and Greek; the plaque is left blank in the image.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several chief priests gesture toward a blank wooden tablet as they speak to Pilate across a table in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:21, where the chief priests ask Pilate to change the wording from the title 'King of the Jews' to the statement that he said he was king. The setting, tablet, and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Pilate sits at a table with a blank document and raises a hand firmly toward a visitor, with a Roman guard and a sunlit city behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Pilate giving his firm reply in John 19:22: what he has written, he has written. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four soldiers examine garments on a rocky hillside, one holding up a pale woven tunic, with crosses in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 19:23, in which the soldiers divide Jesus' garments into four portions and take his seamless tunic, woven from the top throughout.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four soldiers gather around an intact light-colored garment as one casts lots on the ground; others hold garments, with distant crosses on a hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 19:24: the soldiers divide garments and cast lots for the clothing rather than tear it, as the verse says Scripture is fulfilled. The figures, setting, and appearance of the lots are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four women stand closely together beside Jesus on the cross, looking up with sorrow in a rocky landscape beneath a clouded sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 19:25, which places Jesus' mother, his mother's sister, Mary of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene by his cross. The figures' appearances, poses, and landscape are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus looks down from the cross toward his mother and the beloved disciple, who stand together beneath a warm sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:26, where Jesus sees his mother and the disciple he loves standing nearby and tells her to behold her son.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A grieving woman stands beside a compassionate disciple as he welcomes her through the open doorway of a warmly lit home.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the disciple receiving the mother into his own home, inspired by John 19:27. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks from the cross on a rocky hillside, with witnesses standing at a distance beneath a cloudy sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:28, when Jesus, knowing all things had been accomplished, says he thirsts so that Scripture might be fulfilled.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man raises a sponge on a leafy stalk to the mouth of Jesus on the cross, while another holds a vessel of dark liquid nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the verse: a sponge filled with sour wine is placed on hyssop and brought to his mouth, with a full vessel nearby. The figures and setting are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus hangs on the cross with his head bowed. A soldier holds a sponge nearby, a vessel rests below, and two onlookers stand against a warm, distant landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of John 19:30: after Jesus receives sour wine and says it is finished, he bows his head and yields up his spirit. The setting and surrounding figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jewish petitioners speak solemnly to Pilate in a stone courtyard, while three occupied crosses stand on a distant hill.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of the request to Pilate in John 19:31 on the day of Preparation, before the high Sabbath. The scene depicts the request, not the breaking of legs or removal of the bodies.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Soldiers with wooden clubs attend the legs of two men on crosses on either side of a central crucified figure, in a watercolor landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:32, where the soldiers break the legs of the first man and the other man crucified with Him; the scene's visual details are interpretive.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus hangs with bowed head on a cross, his legs unbroken, as two Roman soldiers look up; one holds a lowered club on a rocky hillside at sunset.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 19:33: those who came to Jesus saw that he was already dead and did not break his legs. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor scene of Jesus on the cross as a soldier raises a spear to His side, where blood and water flow; other figures look on against a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:34, where one soldier pierces His side with a spear and blood and water immediately come out. The setting and onlookers are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures earnestly as he speaks to a group listening beneath a tree, with fields and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a witness sharing testimony with listeners reflects the verse’s account of one who has seen and speaks truth so that others may believe.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor scene of Jesus on the cross with his legs intact, above a rocky landscape at sunset; an unlettered scroll rests in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:36: the intact figure and scroll evoke the verse's statement that Scripture was fulfilled and not one of His bones would be broken.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A solemn group looks up at Jesus on the cross, with his pierced side visible, on a rocky hillside above a distant city beneath a warm sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts people looking toward the One they pierced, as described in John 19:37; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Joseph of Arimathea carries Jesus' body tenderly through a rocky landscape at sunset, with Jerusalem in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Joseph taking Jesus' body after Pilate gave permission in John 19:38. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Nicodemus carries a jar and a tied bundle along a rocky path toward a rock-cut entrance, with companions and a donkey carrying more bundles and vessels behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Nicodemus arriving with the abundant mixture of myrrh and aloes described in John 19:39. The setting, companions, containers and appearance are artistic details; his earlier visit by night is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mourners carefully wrap Jesus' body in pale linen on a stone surface, with a bowl of spices nearby, outside a rocky opening in warm evening light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:40, where Jesus' body is bound in linen cloths with spices in preparation for burial; the people and setting are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A flower-filled garden surrounds an open, empty rock-cut tomb, with a wooden cross on a distant hill in warm evening light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the garden at the place where Jesus was crucified and the new tomb in which no one had yet been laid, as described in John 19:41. The garden, tomb, cross, and lighting are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mourners gently lay Jesus, wrapped in linen, on a stone resting place inside a rock-hewn tomb, with a sunlit landscape visible through the entrance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 19:42, in which they lay Jesus in a nearby tomb because of the Jewish Preparation. The people, setting, and visual details are artistic interpretations.
